details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Regexp#to_s could still compile a group cut in the
     middle of characters of a UTF-16 regexp
     - debian/patches/GHSA-7whj-cfh7-xgm4-followup.patch: upstream
       follow-ups of the Regexp#to_s fix in re.c: do not look for an option
       prefix in UTF-16 and UTF-32 regexps, compile the group only when its
       preprocessing keeps the regexp encoding, and set $VERBOSE to nil
       while compiling it
     - GHSA-7whj-cfh7-xgm4 (CVE id pending)
   * This upload also ships the fixes of +tuxcare.els6 to +tuxcare.els8
     below:
     - CVE-2026-132825: one-byte heap buffer overflow when changing the case
       of a sharp s in single-byte encodings
     - GHSA-7x2q-68qv-6p8x: double free in regexp character class
       intersections
     - GHSA-pvgc-g7gj-pv6h: out-of-bounds read in case-insensitive
       backreferences at the end of the string
     - GHSA-wpqw-5qxg-m68r: out-of-bounds read in case-insensitive regexp
       matching, unchecked code point and byte escapes
     - GHSA-87fm-7w84-j2px: integer overflow in String case conversion of
       very long strings
     - GHSA-7whj-cfh7-xgm4: out-of-bounds read in Regexp#to_s of UTF-16
       regexps
     - GHSA-3p8q-wmhx-vm2w: heap buffer overflow from an integer overflow of
       the compiled regexp program size
